name: love-pinyin
description: 小学一年级汉语拼音学习应用：Mac 本地服务与语音引导练习

scripts.validate:content: node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-narration.mjs && node scripts/validate-writing.mjs && node scripts/validate-illustrations.mjs && uv run --locked python -m scripts.validate_daily_reading
scripts.validate:release: node scripts/validate-content.mjs --release && uv run --locked python -m scripts.validate_daily_reading --release
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:content && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:server: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pytest
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:server && npm run test:e2e:local && npm run test:e2e:live
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build && playwright test --config config/playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.prepare:voice: uv run --locked --group voice-build python -m scripts.fetch_tts_model && uv run --locked --group voice-build python -m scripts.build_open_voice && npm run prepare:reading-timing
scripts.test:e2e:product: npm run build && playwright test --config config/playwright.product.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:soak: npm run build && playwright test --config config/playwright.soak.config.ts
scripts.prepare:reading-timing: uv run --locked --group voice-build python -m scripts.fetch_tts_model --config content/reading-alignment-build.json --model-dir models/qwen3-aligner && uv run --locked --group voice-build python -m scripts.build_reading_timings
